title: An acknowledged write, then every member's copy of it
note: The put's answer is the promise: by the time that header came back a quorum had the entry, which is why m2 and m3 can serve it. The stage kills the leader at exactly this point and reads the key from whoever is elected next. A put that never answered carries no such promise and may be missing afterwards, so the tests record which puts returned and demand only those.
